name: Chang Xia
source:
A sophomore at Baiyue High School who is currently the vice president of the cooking club. Loves coffee and all kinds of things related to cooking.

She has known the main character since elementary school, but didn't get to know him well until junior high school. She has enviable relationships at school, and can be seen at various events organized by the school.

She has a delicate mind and always thinks of others, but often ignores her own inner feelings.

She has complicated feelings for the protagonist that are hard to explain.

[From [url=https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/5115]CnGal[/url]]
